payload.artist_html: Phil Senter1*, James I. Kirkland2, John Bird3, Jeff A. Bartlett4
payload.description_html:
Comparison of the maxilla of Geminiraptor suarezarum to those of other paravians.

Maxillae are drawn from photos by P.S. of AMNH (American Museum of Natural History, New York City, New York) FR 6515 (Velociraptor), IVPP V 12615 (Sinovenator), IVPP V 11527 (Sinusonasus), CEUM 7319 (Geminiraptor), IGM (Mongolian Institute of Geology, Ulaan Baatar, Mongolia) 100/983 (Byronosaurus), AMNH FR 6516 (Saurornithoides), and IGM 100/1 (Zanabazar); and reference 18 (Archaeopteryx).
